camel_example: aliyun esa SetAutomaticFrequencyControlConfig --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --ActionType js --Enable on --Level normal
description_en: Sets the intelligent rate limiting threshold for a site
description_zh: 设置站点智能限频阈值
kebab_example: aliyun esa set-automatic-frequency-control-config --site-id 1234560000 --enable on --level normal --action-type js --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetAutomaticFrequencyControlConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version to which the configuration applies. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the feature. Valid values:

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
开关。取值：

off: 关闭

parameters.help_en:
